scene.metaphor: A founder standing before a beautiful but mismatched miniature doorway, realizing the key to the market will not turn into a key to his own life.
scene.setting: A polished studio photograph of a handmade tabletop set on a cool-gray surface: a tiny doorway built from matte foamcore and translucent acrylic sits to the right, glowing from within like a tempting product entrance; Tal stands beside it in the same frame as the human-scale observer.
scene.frozen_incident: At the exact moment Tal pauses at the threshold, a stack of tiny memory cards has slid out of a miniature slot and stopped dead against the door jamb, making the whole product machine look elegantly built but slightly out of fit.
physical_materials: one restrained warm amber light from inside the doorway
tiny printed note cards made from thick stock
scene.image_instruction: Create a serious editorial studio photograph of Tal as a recognizable founder-observer in a handmade miniature set. He stands on the left in a calm, slightly conflicted pose, shoulders relaxed, mouth in a faint knowing half-smile, looking toward a small beautiful doorway on the right that clearly feels like someone else’s world. Build the metaphor from physical objects: a cool-gray foamcore floor, a cobalt-trimmed doorway with mint accents, and a warm amber glow inside. In the doorway, a tiny mechanism of thick index-card-like memory tiles has jammed and spilled one row onto the threshold, frozen harmlessly mid-failure. Keep the scene tactile and practical, with polished studio lighting, crisp shadows, and lots of negative space. Use a restrained palette of cool grays, cobalt, and mint, with only one warm accent from the interior light. Compose laterally so the image reads as a 3:1 banner, but retain one dominant silhouette and a simple scene that still works at thumbnail size.
